jobs.title: Delivery & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
We are a U.S.-led consulting practice that helps small and mid-sized business owners, for-sale-by-owner (FSBO) sellers and shopping-mall owners improve performance. Our clients hire us to turn an improvement plan into action. We need a Delivery and Implementation Specialist to work with business owners and their staff to get agreed improvements done on schedule.

**Requirements**

* At least two years of experience in operations improvement, project coordination, small-business management, retail or restaurant operations, or consulting support.

* Ability to turn an action plan into tasks, owners, deadlines and follow-ups, and to track them to completion.

* Strong written and spoken English, including video calls with business owners.

* Working knowledge of pricing, local marketing, customer service or cost-control practices used by small businesses.

* Comfort with spreadsheets, a CRM and project or task tracking tools.

* Clear, courteous communication and the ability to keep owners and their staff on track.

* Good judgment about when to escalate a question to the CEO or the analyst.

* A reliable computer and internet connection.

**Responsibilities**

* Work with each client to carry out the agreed action plan: pricing and offer changes, local marketing steps, operating and cost improvements, and tenant-mix or leasing tasks supported by our advisor.

* Break each plan into tasks with owners and deadlines, and follow up with client staff.

* Prepare weekly progress updates for clients and for the CEO.

* Record before-and-after figures and evidence supplied by the client, and pass them to the analyst for verification.

* Support quarterly client reviews.

* Document each client's changes, decisions and results in the CRM.

* Flag risks and delays promptly.

This role does not set prices, make contract commitments, give legal or tax advice, or promise results to clients.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a consulting or professional-services firm.

* Experience working with small retail, restaurant, service or property businesses.

* Familiarity with Google Business Profile, point-of-sale reports or basic bookkeeping reports.

**What we offer**

* $1,000 – $1,500 per month, paid in USD.

* Full-time, fully remote.

* Monday to Friday, with a 4-hour daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

* Paid leave and statutory benefits as required in your country; flexible hours outside the overlap window.

* A growing company where future opportunities depend on performance and business needs.

**Work arrangement**

This is a fully remote position reporting to the U.S.-based CEO. You will overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for 4 hours each working day, with the exact window agreed before an offer. Employment classification, benefits and paid leave are confirmed according to the applicable country and engagement arrangement.

Apply through Indeed with your résumé. Shortlisted applicants will be invited by Indeed message to a short case exercise using fictional data. Any later work trial is paid. We accept applications only through Indeed, and we never ask for payment, bank details or government ID numbers.

Aegis Software | Independent Contractor (1099) | Remote, United States

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

Aegis Software is engaging experienced independent contractors to deliver FactoryLogix MES implementations for manufacturing customers, as demand for our software implementations grows. You'll act as the technical consultant on projects you accept: configuring, installing, deploying and integrating Aegis software so it meets the customer's business requirements and runs smoothly in their infrastructure or on a pre-configured cloud instance. Engagements cover the whole implementation lifecycle, from needs assessment and planning through go-live and handoff to support.

This engagement is for an independent, self-directed professional. You decide how and when the work gets done, solve complex deployment problems as they arise, and are accountable for results against each project's scope documents and success criteria.

**ENGAGEMENT TERMS**

Structure: Individual independent contractor (1099). A signed W-9 is required before work starts.

**Length:** Ongoing, reviewed annually by both parties.

**Hours:** No fixed or minimum hours. Work is offered based on project demand, and you choose which projects to accept.

**Location:** Remote, anywhere in the United States. Customer site visits as projects require.

**Travel:** Up to 50% on accepted projects. Reasonable travel expenses are reimbursable as set out in the contractor agreement.

**Rate:** $/per billable hour based on experience

**Invoicing:** Monthly invoice for hours delivered, supported by the billable hours recorded in Aegis's project system. Payment terms per the contractor agreement.

**Agreement:** All terms are governed by a written Independent Contractor Agreement. (ICA)

* Customer requirements: Work with customer executives and end users to understand their business needs and translate requirements into system configurations.

* Integration and readiness: Integrate the software with the customer's existing systems. Before deployment, provide clear guidance so validation and testing are completed ahead of rollout.
* Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues during and after implementation. When an issue can't be resolved right away, document the work done, collect logs and enter clear ticket notes so it can be driven to resolution.

* Billable time records: Record billable hours and reimbursable expenses in Aegis's project system so Aegis can invoice its customers.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years in software implementation, MES/ERP deployment or related technical consulting, including at least two full-lifecycle MES implementations
* Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (queries, scripts)
* Experience deploying to or administering cloud environments (Azure or AWS)
* Experience integrating MES with ERP systems and shop-floor equipment
* Strong troubleshooting skills: able to analyze system issues and determine how to resolve them
* Excellent written and spoken communication with customers and internal teams
* Ability to act as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into technical solutions
* Proven ability to deliver independently with minimal oversight
* Able to travel up to 50% on accepted projects

**Preferred**

* Hands-on FactoryLogix experience
* Background in electronics (SMT/PCBA) or discrete manufacturing
* Familiarity with machine connectivity standards
* Prior independent contracting or consulting experience

This role involves working closely with patients, insurance companies, and Northpoint providers to ensure that all payments are collected in a timely manner, and payer denials/rejections are worked and followed up on to exhaustion, or payment of services. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of the entire billing life cycle of a patient, to include verifications, pre-authorization, utilization review, appeals, claims submission, claims adjudication, and denials. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of insurance guidelines including HMO/PPO, Medicare, Medicaid, and other payer requirements and systems required.

  

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**

* Perform collections to ensure receipt of medical claims within twenty-eight (28) days
* Make outbound telephone calls to insurance companies, and utilize payer portals for claims resolution
* Coordinate with insurance companies to ensure timely payment for services rendered
* Follow existing billing and collection protocols to ensure accurate and timely reimbursement
* Review accounts receivable accounts to ensure accurate reimbursement and identify payer issues affecting payment delays
* Contact payers to get a clear understanding of denials and changes needed to receive payment
* Prepare appeals, when necessary, when claim denials are payer errors
* Document all correspondence with payers in the billing system
* Collaborate and coordinate with Utilization Review for prior authorization/medical necessity documentation
* Knowledge of CMS and Third-party payer regulations and guidelines
* Thorough understanding of Explanation of Benefits
* Maintain accurate records of patient billing and payment information
* Provide reports to management on outstanding balances and collections activity
* Provide excellent communication and customer service skills
* Utilize a strong understanding of insurance billing and coding requirements
* Maintain active working knowledge of Northpoint billing and reimbursement requirements by payer
* Collaborate with RCM team and other departments to ensure successful execution of assigned duties and priorities
* Maintain confidentiality in accordance with established policies and procedures and standards of care
* Adhere to all Company policies and procedures
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned

  

**QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:**

* 2+ years of collections, billing reimbursement, payer relations, or medical Accounts Receivable required
* Experience in a healthcare or behavioral health system with multiple levels of care preferred
* Experience working with commercial medical insurance billing, as well as Medicaid, claims submission, and the technical aspects of billing software
* All-in-one practice management, clearing house and billing software required
* Proficient in navigating through payer portals
* Must be proficient in CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 Codes, DSMS and ASAM criteria, data entry for various third party billing and payers, and their reimbursement and denial patterns
* Ability to work well in a team environment, with ability to triage priorities, delegate tasks if needed, and handle conflict in a reasonable fashion
* Problem-solving skills to research and resolve discrepancies, denials, appeals, collections
* Knowledge of insurance guidelines including HMO/PPO, Medicare, Medicaid, and other payer requirements and systems required
* KIPU or similar EHR/EMR experience preferred
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask
* Familiarity with major payer guidelines
* Agility in managing multiple priorities concurrently
* Meticulous attention to detail and high level of accuracy is key
* Demonstrated ability to develop both internal and external working relationships
* Proven skills in working independently on several projects concurrently

  

**PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

* Sense of ethics, integrity, and confidentiality about employee and business issues
* Ability to work independently and within a dynamic team environment
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge
* Excellent critical thinking skills and organizational abilities
* Excellent communication skills; ability to communicate clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing
* Quickly and effectively identify and resolve problematic situations
* Comfortable analyzing information and dealing with complexity
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Able to handle confidential material in a reliable manner
* Ability to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of organization
* Ability to perform several tasks concurrently with ease and professionalism
* Ability to effectively prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

  

**FULL-TIME BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

* Subsidized Health Insurance Coverage for Employee, Spouse, & Dependent(s)
* 100% Employer Paid Basic Life Insurance equal to 1x annual salary, up to $100,000
* 100% Employer Paid Employee Assistance Program
* Voluntary Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Supplemental Life & AD&D, Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance.
* Pre-tax Savings Accounts for all IRS-allowable medical and dependent care expenses
* Generous Paid Time Off plan
* Employee Referral Bonuses

jobs.description:
**Summary**

The Field Training Lead is responsible for supporting the successful execution of new program rollouts and merchandising initiatives across assigned retail locations by providing supervisory support to a remote team of Field Training Specialists. This role partners closely with field leadership, merchandising teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure installations, resets, and launch activities are completed accurately, on time, and according to company standards.

The Field Training Lead plays a key role in field readiness by assisting with team training support, troubleshooting, operational coordination, and in-store execution during launch periods. This position requires strong supervisory experience as well as excellent organizational skills, adaptability, problem-solving abilities, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, field-driven environment. The Field Training Lead role requires that the incumbent be able to travel within their assigned geography to support hands-on training activities.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**$25 an hour**

* Supervise team of Field Training Specialists to insure alignment across regions of training content, execution, and tracking.
* Support the coordination and execution of new program launches, merchandising resets, and retail installation initiatives across multiple locations and regions.
* Assist field merchandisers with onboarding, training support, project communication, and execution expectations during launch activities.
* Lead field-based training initiatives to improve execution consistency, team readiness, and overall project performance.
* Conduct onsite training and field observations to reinforce best practices, identify performance gaps, and support continuous improvement
* Serve as a point of contact for field team members, supervisors, and store personnel to address questions, provide updates, and resolve issues in real time.
* Monitor daily field activity and project progress to ensure timelines, merchandising standards, and client expectations are met.
* Troubleshoot in-store challenges and help coordinate solutions related to scheduling, staffing, fixtures, product placement, or reporting issues.
* Support launch readiness by ensuring materials, fixtures, signage, and reporting tools are properly distributed and available to field teams.
* Partner with leadership to identify process improvements and opportunities to increase operational efficiency and field execution quality.
* Travel to store locations or regional launches as needed to provide onsite support and operational assistance.
* Build positive relationships with customers, store personnel, vendor partners, and internal teams through professional and responsive communication.
* Comply with all company policies, procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and team support skills
* Excellent organization, time management, and multitasking abilities
* Ability to adapt quickly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable working independently and supporting remote field teams
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow merchandising standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and mobile reporting tools
* Ability to prioritize competing tasks and meet deadlines
* Retail merchandising, field operations, or project coordination experience preferred
* Willingness to travel as needed for launches and field support activities
* Ability to travel regularly to retail locations and launch sites
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 25 pounds as needed during store visits and installations
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including occasional early mornings, evenings, or overnight travel during launch periods

**Experience and Credentials**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* 1-3 years of supervisory or leadership experience required
* 2–4 years of experience in retail, merchandising, or field operations.
* Prior experience training or coaching remote field teams strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry a plus.
* Must have reliable transportation.
  + Must possess a valid state driver's license with proof of current automobile insurance coverage, unless utilizing other means of transportation

  
Compensation: $25
